evaluation_basis: Assessed as an architecture and enforcement-contract stage, not as an empirical alpha experiment.
original_objective: Translate Evidence Before Opinion, point-in-time availability, cost-aware abstention, independent risk and fail-closed execution into reusable code contracts.

engineering_result.summary: The repository documents enforceable seams for evidence, causality, costs, risk, idempotent paper simulation and live-off defaults.

scientific_result.summary: No model or strategy was promoted; advanced ML/RL remained challenger-only pending OOS evidence.

economic_result.summary: Passing v0.8 engineering gates was explicitly not a profitability claim.

limitations: No canonical workflow ID in the stage document
Paper simulator capability did not authorize paper execution
External data families still required availability audits
contribution_to_next_version: Created the common safety/evidence substrate used by later universe discovery and OOS tournaments.
